value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia and Leo. Want me to put any of these on your calendar as reminders?
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3-5 run Saturdays at 10:00, so that suits Mia at 4 and is a weekly class.
Library storytime is free and open to all ages on Tuesdays at 10:30, which works for both of them. The drop-in playgroup is free too, for kids 0-6 on weekday mornings, so Leo can join in.
